provider_policy.scope: Queued subject-model research from WM-XCT-013 onward

waived_providers.reason: The repository owner explicitly instructed the research queue to continue without Grok after repeated structured-output failures.

provider_policy.review_rule: Claude-only results require a separate no-tools adversarial audit and remain reviewable drafts with a visible single-provider hold.

boundary_decision.rationale: Two axes must be kept apart. The frozen registry value standalone-mm classifies the record plane (a world-model record carried standalone in the registry, per record_plane world-model) and is not a member of the subject-model enum, so it cannot be adopted here. On the subject-model axis the defining semantic is a directed, typed, attributable link from a citing context to a cited source that masters neither endpoint: both contract edges (WM-KNW-007 and WM-KNW-010) are inbound REFERENCE, contains_ids and composition_role are empty, and every boundary note reasserts non-ownership of both ends. 'relationship' is therefore the most defensible schema kind. 'aggregate' was considered because the record has independent identity, lifecycle, supersession and four identity-dependent serial artifacts keyed on the record identifier; that behaviour is a consequence of reification, not a change of kind, and 'entity' was rejected because the record has no meaning detached from its two endpoints.

decisions.concept: Aggregate root identification: citation record as root of captures, check reports and verification reports
decisions.rationale: All four serial artifacts key on the citation record identifier plus a never-reused zero-padded ordinal, matching serial_naming_rule exactly; no member carries independent identity, so the root is unambiguous and no member can be orphaned or re-parented.

decisions.concept: Deduplication key composition versus the identity finding's distinguishability claim
decisions.rationale: The create rule collapses a mint onto an existing record when a normalized key matches, but the key's composition is left entirely to open question q-cri-definition. Unless the key includes locus, stance and asserting agent, it contradicts the identity finding's own claim that a record is distinguishable from any other link between the same two endpoints.

decisions.concept: Evidence assessment record identity (record id + scheme id + scheme version, serial:false)
decisions.rationale: q-cal-provenance requires recording assessor independence and q-saa-constraint requires a review cadence for high-consequence citations, so two independent assessments under one scheme version are expected; the declared key collides on them. A never-reused occurrence component is needed without promoting datetime or digest to the key.

decisions.concept: Vocabulary crosswalk identity keyed on the target vocabulary's own version string
decisions.rationale: SRC-009 records no ECO release version on the registry page and SRC-010 carries only 'Updated October 2013', so the declared key is unsatisfiable for two of the five registry_links vocabularies. A declared surrogate version token with its derivation rule is required before the identity strategy is published as normative.

decisions.concept: GRADE certainty binding applied at single-citation granularity
decisions.rationale: GRADE rates certainty for a body of evidence per outcome, while this model excludes aggregation entirely; the conflicts list acknowledges the domain extension but not the unit-of-assessment mismatch. The binding must record the scheme's own unit of assessment alongside the version pin.

decisions.concept: Fixity values and selectors surviving redaction of personal-data excerpts
decisions.disposition: accepted for draft, held for privacy review
decisions.rationale: The delete rule states unconditionally that selectors and digests survive redaction so re-verification stays possible. Over a short special-category excerpt a retained digest remains a checkable value, and regional_assumptions only defer generically to overriding regimes rather than qualifying this specific rule.

decisions.concept: Access scope enumeration (bundle, layer, finding, artifact) versus record, excerpt and capture disclosure rules
decisions.rationale: The enumerated scopes are documentation-structure levels while the default rule, exceptions and q-aac-access all govern instance components. Only 'artifact' maps cleanly to a capture; the mismatch must be annotated in the draft rather than published as a coherent scope vocabulary.

decisions.concept: Contested-flag procedure with a role responsibility and a question but no function
decisions.rationale: The Evidence verifier role must raise contested and drift flags and q-cce-process asks who runs the raise, review and clear procedure, yet none of the 11 functions covers it. Single-provider mode forbids adding a function, so this is recorded as an open structural gap rather than invented.

decisions.concept: Alignment authoring and conformance re-test with no covering function
decisions.rationale: The compatibility rule invalidates a conformance claim when a target version changes and the steward role must re-test it, but the function set only projects a record to an exchange profile. The maintenance path for the crosswalk artifact is therefore unexecutable as specified.

decisions.concept: Registry parent_ids WM-KNW-007 versus the REFERENCE-only relationship contract
decisions.rationale: contains_ids, composition_role and default_link_type are empty and both contract edges point inward as REFERENCE. A compositional reading of parent_ids would contradict the model's independent identity, lifecycle and supersession, so it must be read as taxonomy placement under NAV.INF.KNW.EVD.

decisions.concept: Checklist rows 'access' and 'retention and deletion' marked covered
decisions.rationale: The model explicitly disclaims request evaluation, enforcement, the audit trail, schedule ownership, hold determination and erasure execution. An unqualified 'covered' overstates what the record supplies and invites an adopter to assume delegation targets exist.

decisions.concept: Cited-source arity of a single citation record
decisions.rationale: q-ccb-constraint governs whether one record may serve several citing contexts, but nothing constrains the cited-source side. With aggregation and argument schemes out of scope, one cited source per record should be stated explicitly rather than left inferable.

decisions.concept: SRC-012 schema.org ClaimReview as the sole tier-3 mapping target
decisions.rationale: It carries a fast-moving version string (30.0, 19 March 2026) and drives the declared conflict over whether the verdict rating sits on the review or with the citing claim model; that crosswalk decision cannot be restated without re-verifying the pinned version.

decisions.concept: Rejection of a local publisher or author trust-score layer
decisions.rationale: The unsupported-structure adversarial check is sound: no source in the set defines a governed trust vocabulary, and binding certainty to an external version-pinned scheme instead of inventing a local scale is the correct discipline for a source-grounded model.

deferred_research: Pin a resolvable ECO release IRI or dated version for SRC-009 and record the derivation rule for the surrogate version token used in the crosswalk artifact key.

Resolve the CiTO version discrepancy (2.8.2 in the current SPAR build versus 2.8.1 dated 16 February 2018 in secondary indexes) against the namespace itself and record which build the stance mapping was tested against.

Verify whether any later IETF specification updates or profiles RFC 3339 in a way that affects the declared timestamp rule, particularly the -00:00 convention and the RFC 1123 conversion at the Memento protocol boundary.
Define the normalized deduplication key and its interaction with q-cri-definition, then re-test it against the case of two opposing-stance records over the same citing context.

Determine how the unconditional survival of excerpt digests through redaction interacts with erasure obligations over short special-category excerpts, and whether a salted or truncated fixity form preserves re-verifiability without preserving a checkable value.

Assign ownership and a procedure for raising, reviewing and clearing the contested flag, and reconcile it with the Evidence verifier role responsibilities before any function is added in a future multi-provider pass.
Specify the alignment authoring and conformance re-test path required by the compatibility rule and the Vocabulary and alignment steward role, which currently has no covering function.

Identify an authoritative source for jurisdiction-neutral chain-of-custody and admissibility duties, or confirm the gap is unclosable from any defensible source set, before the legal-admissibility checklist row is revisited.
Establish whether the schema.org ClaimReview verdict rating sits with the review or with the citing claim model, and record the decision explicitly in the crosswalk as the conflicts list requires.
publication_holds: Live source and version verification is outstanding for all 13 sources. SRC-003 (CiTO 2.8.2 versus the 2.8.1 dated 2018 cited elsewhere), SRC-009 (ECO, no release version recorded at all), SRC-010 (GRADE handbook, 'Updated October 2013' only), SRC-011 (C2PA 2.2), SRC-012 (schema.org 30.0) and SRC-008 (VC Data Model 2.0) must each be re-resolved and re-pinned before any alignment or conformance claim is restated in a published artifact.

Independent second-provider review is absent by explicit owner authorization: Grok was waived by the repository owner at 2026-08-29T09:06:27Z after repeated structured-output failures. Every publication artifact must carry a visible single-provider hold, name the waived provider and the authorizing party, and the result remains a reviewable draft rather than an adjudicated model.

Registry status candidate and review_state boundary-review-required must remain in force until the parent_ids link to WM-KNW-007 is confirmed as navigational placement rather than composition, since a compositional reading would invalidate the accepted relationship entry kind.

The normalized deduplication key composition must be bound (locus, stance and asserting agent at minimum) before any implementation or interface guidance is published, because the create rule as written can silently merge legitimately distinct assertions.

The evidence-assessment-record identity strategy must gain a never-reused occurrence component before the artifact identity rules are published as normative, otherwise an independent re-assessment under the same scheme version is unrepresentable.
Independent second-provider review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this Claude-only result remains a reviewable draft.
